title: Influence of the low-degree truncation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $d\in\mathbb N$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The influence of coordinate $i$ on the Fourier truncation of $f$ to frequencies of size at most $d$ is at most its influence on $f$.
